ZEN ZOMBIE GARDEN

Moonlit Garden Survival Shooter
Move: WASD   Sprint: Shift   Jump: Space   Shoot: L-Click   Aim: R-Click   Reload: R   Camera: V   Pause: Esc
ZOMBIES
Endless waves of ghostly spirits await in a moonlit zen garden. Survive, upgrade, and fight the darkness.
🌑 Story Mode is coming soon!

How To Play

Survive

Endless waves of ghostly zombies approach from the darkness. Stay alive as long as you can.

Controls

WASD Move   Shift Sprint   Space Jump   Mouse Look   L-Click Shoot   R-Click Aim (ADS)   R Reload   F Buy / Upgrade   Tab Inventory   1-9 Switch Weapon   V Camera View   X Airplane   C Sentry   Esc Pause

Earn Coins

Kill zombies for coins. Visit wall stations to buy weapons, use the Mystery Box for random guns, then Pack-a-Punch for devastating upgrades.

Mystery Box

For 520 coins, the Mystery Box gives you a random weapon — but the legendary Ray Gun and 🚀 Gun Launcher are extremely rare!

Power-Ups

Zombies occasionally drop glowing gems — grab them for Max Ammo, Insta-Kill, Double Points, Fire Sale, or a screen-clearing Nuke.

Boss Waves

Every 10th wave summons a powerful boss. Defeat it for massive coin rewards.

Zen Coins & Shop

Surviving matches earns Zen Coins 🪙 — a permanent currency. Spend them in the Shop on new skins, bullet tracer colors, and single-use gameplay boosts.

Season Pass

Matches also earn Season XP 🔵. Each tier unlocks a free reward — cosmetics, coins, or boosts. Reach Tier 30 for the ultimate prize!

Arsenal

Buy guns with 🪙 Zen Coins — they're permanently yours, and you pick 3 guns + melee as your loadout for every match. You have 🪙0

⚔ GATEKEEPER

Tomahawk survival with a devastating secret weapon. No wall weapons. No mercy. Just you, your axe, the Requiem, and the horde.

Core Mechanics
Perfect Parry — Swing right as a zombie attacks to parry: i-frames + instant kill
Tactical Block — Hold Right-Click to raise your tomahawk and block, reducing damage by 75%
Sharpness Tax — Every hit dulls your blade. Dull axe = less damage
On-the-Fly Sharpening — Press R to sharpen mid-combat (you're vulnerable!)
Infinite Lethality — A freshly sharpened axe one-shots any zombie
⚔ Gatekeeper Rule
Each wave rolls a random rule that changes the fight:
Glass Jaw — Zombies fragile, +50% zombie damage
Frenzy — Sprinting horde, wider parry windows
Brittle Edge — Axe dulls 2x faster
Precision — Tight parry timing, parries restore sharpness
Swarm — Double zombies, fragile health
Duelist — Boss spawns, parries deal 5x damage
🤖 AI Director Reward
After each wave, the AI Director grades your performance:
S — Flawless — Full sharpness + 40 HP
A — Excellent — +85 sharpness + 25 HP
B — Solid — +70 sharpness + 15 HP
C — Struggling — +50 sharpness + 5 HP
D — Battered — +30 sharpness, no heal
Graded on: HP kept, parry rate, sharpness maintained
🔥 Core Loop
Kill Combo — Consecutive kills build a damage multiplier (+3% per combo)
Parry Streak — Back-to-back parries stack for bigger rewards
The Cycle: Parry incoming → Combo kills → Sharpen at safe moments → Survive the rule → Earn AI reward → Next wave
⚠ No wall weapons, no mystery box, no Pack-a-Punch.
Your tomahawk is your primary defense. Guard the garden. Survive.
🔫 Requiem Magnum — Leon's DSO assault revolver. 5 rounds. Devastating damage. Press 2 to switch. Earn ammo from S/A/B AI Director ranks.

🌼 UNDERTALE: THE RUINS

Golden flowers and violet stone in the cavern beneath the mountain. An homage to the Underground.

The Ruins
Golden Flowers — The yellow flowers that scattered across the surface now bloom in the gloom
Violet Stone — Ancient rock walls, lit by warm torchlight and glowing veins
Checkerboard Plaza — A great tiled hall at the heart of the cavern
The Golden Door — A tall gate sealed with violet light. Beyond it... the rest of the Underground
Ruins Melody — A gentle track straight out of the Ruins
🗺 Full Survival
A classic endless-wave round, played in the cavern beneath the mountain.
Wall stations, Mystery Box, Pack-a-Punch, and the AAT machine all await.
Survive the horde. Stay determined.

🍕 FREDDY FAZBEAR'S PIZZA

A family pizza place where the animatronics come alive at night. Survive the horror.

The Pizzeria
Main Dining Room — You spawn in the center of a checkered-tile dining room
Birthday Tables — Rows of party tables with pizza, balloons, and party hats
The Show Stage — Dark velvet curtain stage where Freddy, Bonnie & Chica stand still... for now
Pirate Cove — Foxy's curtained alcove west of the show stage. He watches from the dark...
Arcade Corner — Glowing arcade machines along the walls
Kitchen Doorway — A dark passage on the east wall
⚠ The Animatronics
Freddy Fazbear — Brown bear with a top hat. The leader. Center stage.
Bonnie — Purple rabbit with long ears. Left side of stage.
Chica — Yellow chicken with a "LET'S EAT" bib. Right side of stage.
Foxy — The mangled pirate fox with a hook hand and eyepatch. Hides in Pirate Cove.
They stand still while a 3-minute wake timer runs. When the clock hits zero, Freddy Fazbear awakens as the final boss. Disable him for a big reward — then the night keeps going, and he returns again. Survive as long as you can.
🍕 Features
Colorful Stage Lights — Pulsing spotlights in red, green, blue, orange, pink
Checkered Tile Floor — Classic pizzeria aesthetic
Birthday Decorations — Bunting, banners, balloons, and party hats everywhere
Wall Weapons — Buy guns from the walls to fight off the horde

🌑 Story Mode — The Red Moon

The moon bleeds crimson, and the garden's guardian has been corrupted by the blight. Journey through five chapters, slay the corrupted guardians, and confront The Devourer of Dawn. Each chapter pays out Zen Coins 🪙 and XP.
